robert2026.title: Impact analysis of flood-induced changes in geographical accessibility and coverage to healthcare in both public and private sector, 2024, Kenya
robert2026.review_scope: Primary article methods, discussion, availability and source references; supplement text; linked portal metadata and terms. Published model summaries were read, not treated as independent observations.
robert2026.method_limit: AccessMod potential travel-time modeling with flood/closure inputs and assumed speed changes. Sensitivity ranges are not confidence intervals or observed journey times.
robert2026.facility_availability: Paper refers to Ministry of Health contact page for the census input; no immutable eligible facility list or reuse grant found there. The page request failed certificate validation; verification was not disabled.
robert2026.roads_provenance: Supplement describes a 2018 road survey classified using the proposed 2023 register. This distinguishes observation year from classification vintage.
robert2026.roads_rights: Linked KRB portal requires prior written consent, limits use to the stated purpose, and restricts transfer. No consent supplied. No road layers acquired.

flood_metadata.snippet: This is a flood extent layer generated from Sentinel 1 SAR imagery aggregagated over a period of time (March - May 2024).

robert2026.flood_qualification: Public item access is not a reuse grant. No item data endpoint requested. Methods and item metadata identify Sentinel-1; article availability text says Sentinel-2. Acquisition dates must be resolved separately from portal timestamps.
robert2026.repositories: Article availability lists source portals, not a pinned study code/data release. No GitHub link appears in article or supplement. UNOSAT link is a general products catalog, not an immutable input inventory.
robert2026.eligibility: Unqualified candidate only; no substitution or validation-set adoption. Rights, snapshots and observation independence remain unresolved. The separate Macharia closure-report route is assessed below.

macharia_kenya_closure_route.provenance: The author's reply of 2026-10-17 was read directly in the owner's mailbox on 2026-10-26 at the owner's request. It supersedes the earlier owner-provided paraphrase, which it matches. Message headers were not independently authenticated.
macharia_kenya_closure_route.reviewed_reply_content: Road closures came from newspaper reports and articles gathered during the flood period, supplemented by official closure records from Kenyan road authorities. The author cannot provide systematic observation dates, vehicle scope or segment IDs. Only segments reported as flooded were captured, so some affected roads are likely missing. The closures are not a standalone validated dataset; they were one input alongside the satellite flood extents. For matching, reported closures were manually identified and split on the study road network in ArcMap and flagged as flooded or not in the attribute table. No independent model or source was used to cross-check; the reports were the ground truth.
macharia_kenya_closure_route.owner_reported_content: The closure reports came from newspapers and Kenyan road-authority records. They record flooded roads only, lack dates, vehicle scope and segment IDs, and overlap the model inputs.
macharia_kenya_closure_route.positive_only_estimand: A separately collected, independent list of matchable reported closures could support reported-positive capture: matched reported closures identified by the model divided by all matchable reported closures. A positive-only list cannot establish population recall, specificity, false-positive rate or precision. An unreported road is unknown, not open.
macharia_kenya_closure_route.eligibility: On the reviewed reply, this particular Kenya closure-report route is ineligible for independent final evaluation: source overlap defeats independence and the missing time, segment and vehicle fields prevent reliable matching. Flooded-road status alone does not establish vehicle passability. Even reported-positive capture is not qualified here. This does not exclude every possible Kenya source or change the adopted Idai finish line.
macharia_kenya_closure_route.what_would_change_status: A separately sourced, licensed and immutable observation set with provenance independent of model inputs, explicit time and vehicle scope, segment matching and coverage. Any change to the evaluation claim or study area needs an explicit scope decision.
